fees.notes: UNIMAS official international undergraduate programme fee (Faculty of Economics and Business): tuition RM4,000/semester + recurrent RM1,620/semester + non-recurring RM1,280 = RM35,000 total for 6 semesters. per_year = total / 3yr nominal duration. Source: https://www.global.unimas.my/admission/undergraduate (accessed 2026-09-18).
